name: Commission proposal
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the European Defence Industry Programme and a framework of measures to ensure the timely availability and supply of defence products (‘EDIP’)
part_text:
The European Parliament wants a new European Defence Industry Programme to help Europe's defence industry make weapons and equipment faster and in greater quantities, and to help Ukraine rebuild its own defence industry. It asks for much more money than the Commission proposed: at least 15 billion euros from Member States for European industry and 5 billion for Ukraine, on top of 1.5 billion from the EU budget. It also sets rules for joint buying, supply crises and a new fund for small companies.

- The EU would fund joint defence purchases, factory expansion and a loan and equity fund for small firms.
- It affects defence companies, Member States' armed forces and Ukraine's defence industry.
- Parliament adopted its position; talks with Member States on the final law come next.
